description: Mark DeCaprio's values center on community service, accountability, and dedication to the 48th District. He champions transparent government, fiscal responsibility, and policies that support families, businesses, and individuals. Committed to making Connecticut more affordable, Mark opposes unnecessary mandates and fights for middle-class tax relief. He believes in efficient government that improves public safety, education, and infrastructure to enhance residents' quality of life.
title: Values | DeCaprio 4 CT 48th
